description: A sampler id that IS a curated solver and IS on the model's menu, but which this family cannot honor on a chained pass because the same name selects a different lane on its flat path (MLX SDXL's `lcm` and `euler_ancestral`). A family declares those in `unhonorableSamplers`; the published per-pass menu subtracts them and the floor rejects them, from that one declaration. Refusing an id while still publishing it was the advertise/honor mismatch this story exists to close, one layer up. This is a CAPABILITY gap (typed Error::Unsupported), distinct from `unknownId`: the id IS on the menu and IS curated.
